overview: Federated alliance guided by the Unity Council. Strategy channels into Harmony (de-escalation), Synthesis (trade & infrastructure), and Reconciliation (cultural healing). Instruments include Edicts of Unity, Bridge Charters, and Concord Writs.

pillars.name: Synthesis
pillars.focus: Trade lanes, energy and data infrastructure, joint standards

pillars.name: Reconciliation
pillars.focus: Cultural exchanges, memory work, civic stabilization

operations.summary: Mediator teams stabilize outer-rim disputes with verifiable ceasefires.
Bridge Charters knit rival markets into shared corridors.
Cultural and educational programs heal long-broken civic memory.
